Featured.name: Crispy Jalapeño Cream Cheese Bites (v)
Featured.description: Crispy breaded jalapeño peppers filled with smooth, creamy cheese, with a gentle chilli kick and crunchy golden coating. Served with a dip. Suitable for vegetarians.

Featured.name: Thai Pulled Pork Bao Bun
Featured.description: A soft, fluffy bao bun generously filled with tender Thai pulled pork. Rich, savoury and full of flavour—a delicious little starter.

Featured.name: Massaman Curry
Featured.description: Our Massaman Curry is a rich, mild Thai curry with deep, warming flavour — slow-cooked with fragrant Massaman spices and whole cardamom pods, creamy coconut milk, and a gentle sweetness balanced with savoury depth. Comforting, aromatic, and seriously moreish. Please order your choice of rice separately. Peanuts are optional.

Featured.name: Thai Yellow Chicken Curry with Homemade Roti
Featured.description: Tender chicken and potatoes simmered in a rich, aromatic Thai yellow curry with creamy coconut milk and warming spices. Mild, fragrant and deeply comforting, served with our freshly made Thai roti for tearing, dipping and soaking up every drop of the curry sauce. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Featured.name: Crispy Aromatic Duck & Pancakes
Featured.description: A generous half crispy aromatic duck, and served with soft pancakes, fresh cucumber, spring onions and rich hoisin sauce. Crisp skin, tender duck and all the proper trimmings — perfect for sharing, but easy to keep to yourself. Duck served unshredded to retain moisture.

Featured.name: Tasty Thai Red Curry Stir Fry
Featured.description: Ignite your senses with our chef-crafted dry red curry stir-fry. Wok-tossed without coconut milk for a punchier flavor, tender slices of meat are combined with crisp bamboo shoots and vibrant green beans in a rich, aromatic spice blend. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Featured.name: Nam Tok Moo – Thai “Waterfall” Pork Salad
Featured.description: A classic from North-East Thailand: tender sliced pork tossed warm with fresh mint, red onion, spring onion and herbs, finished with a punchy lime-chilli dressing and toasted rice for that signature nutty crunch. Fresh, savoury, zingy — and properly moreish.

Featured.name: Crispy Coast Starter Sharing Plate (min 2 people)
Featured.description: A proper Thai starter sharing platter built for two or more, packed with our best bits. Includes homemade spring rolls, authentic Thai fish cakes, large prawn cakes (Tod Man Kung), salt and pepper squid, and crunchy prawn crackers with lime. Served with dipping sauces for a delicious mix of crispy, juicy flavors.

Featured.name: Street Food Meaty Sharing Plate (Min. 2 People)
Featured.description: Explore an array of bold flavors with this meaty street-food platter. Enjoy crispy chicken wings, juicy meatballs, and delicate steamed dumplings alongside tender pork ribs and crunchy prawn crackers. Perfectly paired with zesty dipping sauces.

Featured.name: Stir Fried Chicken with Ginger
Featured.description: Experience the aromatic charm of our Stir Fried Chicken with Ginger. This classic dish features sliced chicken wok-tossed with plenty of fresh, zingy ginger and crisp garden vegetables in our signature savory sauce. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Appetisers.name: Crispy Whitebait
Appetisers.description: Starter portion of lightly coated crispy whitebait, fried until golden and served with a fresh lime wedge and creamy tartare sauce. A proper crunchy seafood side — salty, moreish, and perfect for sharing or adding alongside your main.

Appetisers.name: Breaded Mushrooms
Appetisers.description: Savor a tempting snack with our golden breaded mushrooms, featuring a light, crunchy coating and a tender, earthy center. Perfectly fried and incredibly moreish, they are served alongside a cool, creamy dipping sauce.

Appetisers.name: Thai Khanom Jeep Chicken
Appetisers.description: Enjoy a taste of authentic Thai market culture with our steamed chicken Khanom Jeep. These delicate, dim sum-style dumplings are filled with savory chicken and served with a rich soy dipping sauce.

Appetisers.name: Handmade Thai Prawn Cakes (3 Large) (Tod Mun Goong)
Appetisers.description: Savor the authentic taste of Thailand with three large, handmade Tod Mun Goong prawn cakes. Crafted with real chopped prawns and aromatic seasonings, these golden-fried treats offer a satisfyingly crisp bite paired with sweet chilli sauce.

Appetisers.name: Handmade Thai Fishcakes (Proper Ones)
Appetisers.description: Discover the true essence of Thai street food with our fragrant, handmade fishcakes. Pan-fried to a light crisp, these herb-packed delights are made in-house using real fish for a soft, authentic texture. Served with sweet chilli and fresh cucumber.

Appetisers.name: Vegetable Spring Rolls (2)
Appetisers.description: Enjoy a light and crunchy Thai classic with our two handmade vegetable spring rolls. Fried to a golden crisp, these flavorful rolls are filled with fresh vegetables and served with sweet chilli dipping sauce.

Appetisers.name: Vegetable Spring Rolls (3)
Appetisers.description: Delight in a triple serving of our signature Thai appetizer with three handmade vegetable spring rolls. Fried to a perfect golden crunch, these savory rolls are bursting with fresh vegetables and paired with sweet chilli sauce.

Appetisers.name: Street Food Pork Jerky Snack
Appetisers.description: Experience an authentic taste of Thailand with our Moo Daet Diaw. This homemade street food snack features tender pork that has been marinated, sun-dried, and fried to perfection. Served with fresh cucumber slices and a signature spicy dipping sauce.

Appetisers.name: Thai Prawn Crackers
Appetisers.description: Treat yourself to a portion of our irresistibly crispy Thai Prawn Crackers. Packed with authentic spice and rich flavor, these traditional crackers are served with a side of sweet chilli sauce for the perfect dip.

Appetisers.name: Salt & Pepper Squid
Appetisers.description: Enjoy a zesty seafood delight with eight pieces of tender squid, perfectly breaded and fried to a light, crispy finish. Seasoned with salt and pepper, it’s served with a fresh lime wedge and your choice of sweet or spicy dipping sauce.

Soups & Salads.name: Nam Tok Moo – Thai “Waterfall” Pork Salad
Soups & Salads.description: A classic from North-East Thailand: tender sliced pork tossed warm with fresh mint, red onion, spring onion and herbs, finished with a punchy lime-chilli dressing and toasted rice for that signature nutty crunch. Fresh, savoury, zingy — and properly moreish.

Soups & Salads.name: Mushroom Larb (V)
Soups & Salads.description: Savor the bold, vibrant flavors of Thailand with our Mushroom Larb. This zesty salad features sliced mushrooms tossed with fresh mint, spring onion, and red onion, all balanced with a punchy lime and chilli dressing. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Soups & Salads.name: Larb Gai (Warm Thai Chicken Larb Salad)
Soups & Salads.description: A bright, punchy Thai street food classic. Minced chicken tossed with fresh mint, spring onion, red onion and toasted rice for that signature nutty crunch, all finished in our house larb dressing (lime-forward, savoury, and lightly spicy). Fresh, fragrant, and seriously moreish. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Soups & Salads.name: Tom Kha
Soups & Salads.description: Warm your soul with our creamy Tom Kha, a delicate Thai soup crafted with coconut milk, fragrant lemongrass, and earthy galangal. This mildly spiced classic is light yet deeply satisfying. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Soups & Salads.name: Tom Yum
Soups & Salads.description: Ignite your senses with our authentic Tom Yum, a vibrant Thai soup renowned for its bold, hot, and spicy profile. Featuring your choice of protein, this classic dish is infused with aromatic herbs for a truly refreshing kick. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Curry Dishes.name: Massaman Curry

Curry Dishes.name: Thai Green Curry
Curry Dishes.description: Experience the soul-warming flavors of Thailand with our traditional Green Curry. This creamy dish features your choice of tender chicken, pork, or beef in rich coconut milk. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Curry Dishes.name: Penang Curry
Curry Dishes.description: Savor the rich, nutty notes of our Penang Curry, a thick and fragrant Thai classic. Tender meat or tofu is simmered in creamy coconut milk and aromatic spices for a deep, warming richness. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Curry Dishes.name: Thai Red Curry with Coconut Milk
Curry Dishes.description: Indulge in the bold, aromatic heat of our traditional Thai Red Curry. Simmered with creamy coconut milk and tender bamboo shoots, this dish offers a perfect balance of spice and richness. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Curry Dishes.name: Cauliflower Thai Green Curry (V)
Curry Dishes.description: Embrace a comforting, plant-based delight with our Cauliflower Thai Green Curry. Fresh, tender cauliflower is simmered in a creamy coconut milk base infused with aromatic herbs and a gentle, warming heat. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Curry Dishes.name: Vegetarian Thai Green Curry
Curry Dishes.description: Enjoy a vibrant and authentic plant-based feast with our Vegetarian Thai Green Curry. This creamy classic features tender tofu and garden-fresh vegetables simmered in our signature homemade vegetarian sauce. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Stir Fries.description: Ignite your senses with our chef-crafted dry red curry stir-fry. Stir Fries.name: Sweet & Sour (Pad Prieow Wan)
Stir Fries.description: A bright, colourful Thai sweet and sour stir-fry cooked with pineapple, peppers, onion, tomato and vegetables in a rich, glossy sauce. Fresh, tangy and lightly sweet with plenty of savoury depth — a proper feel-good Thai classic. Please order your choice of rice separately. Choose your protein: chicken, pork or king prawns.

Stir Fries.name: Stir Fried Chicken & Cashew Nuts
Stir Fries.description: Treat yourself to the perfect crunch with our Stir Fried Chicken & Cashew Nuts. This crowd-favorite features crispy pieces of chicken wok-tossed with golden roasted cashews and vibrant vegetables in a glossy, savory glaze. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Stir Fries.name: Pad Thai
Stir Fries.description: Treat your tastebuds to our signature Pad Thai, a beautiful harmony of sweet, tangy, and savory flavors. Thin rice noodles are expertly wok-tossed in our rich, homemade sauce with crisp beansprouts and eggs, then finished with fresh coriander, a generous dusting of crushed peanuts, and a squeeze of lime.

Stir Fries.name: Vegetarian Pad Thai
Stir Fries.description: Enjoy the perfect balance of sweet, sour, and savory with our Vegetarian Pad Thai. Thin rice noodles are wok-tossed with mixed vegetables and egg in our signature homemade sauce, finished with crushed peanuts, spicy chilli flakes, and a squeeze of fresh lime.

Stir Fries.name: Pad Ka Prao
Stir Fries.description: Ignite your taste buds with our authentic Pad Ka Prao, a beloved Thai street food classic. Your choice of minced chicken or beef is wok-fried with aromatic holy basil and fresh chillies, topped with a crispy fried egg. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Stir Fries.name: Pad Prik Thai Dum
Stir Fries.description: Awaken your palate with the bold, peppery kick of our Pad Prik Thai Dum. Your choice of tender meat is wok-fried with crushed black peppercorns and vibrant garden vegetables for a deep, aromatic flavor that truly lingers. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Stir Fries.name: Pad Neua sai Makhuea
Stir Fries.description: Savor a hearty and flavorful Thai classic with our Beef and Aubergine stir-fry. Savory minced beef is wok-tossed with tender chunks of aubergine, fresh basil, and chillies in our signature homemade sauce for a rich, satisfying finish. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Stir Fries.name: Stir Fried Tofu with Vegetables (v)
Stir Fries.description: Delight in a healthy plant-based classic. Our Stir Fried Tofu with Vegetables features golden tofu pieces wok-tossed with fresh broccoli, mushrooms, and cauliflower in our authentic Thai vegetarian seasoning for a crisp, savory finish. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Stir Fries.name: Pad Nam Man Hoi
Stir Fries.description: Indulge in our tender Beef Top Rump, expertly marinated and wok-fried in a rich, savory oyster sauce. Tossed with a selection of crisp garden vegetables, this classic stir-fry offers a deep, succulent flavor that is both simple and satisfying. Please order your choice of rice separately.

Chicken.name: Crispy Tender Sticks (2 Skewers)
Chicken.description: Treat yourself to a crunchy, crowd-pleasing favorite: two hand-breaded chicken skewers fried to golden perfection. Served alongside hot, crispy fries and your choice of dipping sauce for a simple and incredibly satisfying meal.

Chicken.name: Crispy Tender Sticks (3 Skewers)
Chicken.description: Experience a triple dose of crunch with these three succulent, hand-breaded chicken skewers. Fried to a beautiful golden brown and served with plenty of hot, crispy fries and your favorite dipping sauce.

Chicken.name: Thai Chicken 8 inch Wrap
Chicken.description: Tender, crispy-coated chicken breast strips served in a warm artisan stone-baked flatbread. Layered with fresh mixed greens, sweet onions, and drizzled with your choice of rich, flavourful sauce for a filling and satisfying gourmet wrap.

Kids.description: Bite-sized pieces of tender chicken breast coated in a crispy golden crumb, made fresh in-house. Served with our signature three-times-cooked fries and a side of dipping sauce — a tasty, crunch-filled favorite kids will love!

Fries & Rice.name: Breaded Mushrooms
Fries & Rice.description: Savor a tempting snack with our golden breaded mushrooms, featuring a light, crunchy coating and a tender, earthy center. Perfectly fried and incredibly moreish, they are served alongside a cool, creamy dipping sauce.

Fries & Rice.name: Jasmine Rice
Fries & Rice.description: Elevate your meal with our authentic Steamed Jasmine Rice. Renowned for its delicate floral aroma and perfectly soft, fluffy texture, this fragrant long-grain rice is the essential companion for soaking up the bold flavors of our signature Thai curries and stir-fries.

Fries & Rice.name: Thai Sticky Rice
Fries & Rice.description: Thai glutinous rice (does not contain allergenic gluten) which is a glorious slightly chewy change to jasmine rice and most often eaten with sides and warm salads of sliced and grilled meats such as satay, larb, nam tok and similar. Feel free to eat with fingers!

Fries & Rice.name: Egg Fried Rice
Fries & Rice.description: Experience the comforting taste of our classic Egg Fried Rice. Fluffy Jasmine rice is expertly wok-fried with fresh eggs and traditional Thai seasonings to create a fragrant, savory side that perfectly complements any of our main dishes.

Drinks.name: Tango Apple Zero
Drinks.description: Tango Apple Zero combines crisp apple flavor with fizzy refreshment without the sugar, making it a guilt-free beverage choice in a 330 mL can.

Cakes & Desserts.name: Ultimate Fudgy Chocolate Brownie (1 piece)
Cakes & Desserts.description: Deep, chocolatey and seriously indulgent. Each rich chocolate brownie is baked for a dense, soft and fudgy centre with an intensely chocolatey finish - 1 piece is enough richness for most people. Perfect when you need something sweet after your savories.
